headline: US Stock Benchmarks Fall Into Correction Territory Over AI Sector Worries
summary: Major U.S. stock indexes declined sharply on Friday, pushing all three primary benchmarks into correction territory. Persistent selling pressure across artificial intelligence technology stocks also spread to commodity markets.
why: A stock market correction is defined as a 10% decline from recent peak levels. Pulldowns in major U.S. stock indexes directly affect global market sentiment and institutional asset allocations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Broad risk aversion surrounding AI sector valuations pushed major U.S. equity benchmarks into correction territory.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Broad risk-off sentiment and profit taking in high-valuation technology companies pushed U.S. benchmark indices into correction territory.
